description: This file defines the SystemInfo class and related functions for retrieving system information such as memory, CPU load, hostname, and environment variables within the WPEFramework project. It also declares external functions and metadata related to the module.

classes.name: SystemInfo
classes.description: A singleton class providing access to system information such as memory, CPU load, hostname, environment variables, and system time.

classes.name: SystemInfo::MemorySnapshot
classes.description: A nested class within SystemInfo that captures a snapshot of memory and swap statistics, and can output this data as a JSON string.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Id
methods.description: Generates a device ID based on raw device data and a key length.

methods.name: SystemInfo::GetEnvironment
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an environment variable.

methods.name: SystemInfo::SetEnvironment
methods.description: Sets the value of an environment variable, with an option to force the change.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of SystemInfo.

methods.name: SystemInfo::~SystemInfo
methods.description: Destructor for the SystemInfo class.

methods.name: SystemInfo::SetTime
methods.description: Sets the system time.

methods.name: SystemInfo::SetTimeZone
methods.description: Sets the system time zone.

methods.name: SystemInfo::GetHostName
methods.description: Returns the hostname of the system.

methods.name: SystemInfo::GetTotalRam
methods.description: Returns the total RAM in the system.

methods.name: SystemInfo::GetPageSize
methods.description: Returns the system's memory page size.

methods.name: SystemInfo::GetPhysicalPageCount
methods.description: Calculates the number of physical memory pages.

methods.name: SystemInfo::GetUpTime
methods.description: Returns the system uptime.

methods.name: SystemInfo::GetFreeRam
methods.description: Returns the amount of free RAM.

methods.name: SystemInfo::GetTotalSwap
methods.description: Returns total swap space.

methods.name: SystemInfo::GetFreeSwap
methods.description: Returns free swap space.

methods.name: SystemInfo::GetCpuLoad
methods.description: Returns the current CPU load.

methods.name: SystemInfo::GetCpuLoadAvg
methods.description: Returns the CPU load averages.

methods.name: SystemInfo::MemorySnapshot::AsJSON
methods.description: Outputs the memory snapshot as a JSON string.

methods.name: SystemInfo::MemorySnapshot::Total
methods.description: Returns total memory captured in the snapshot.

methods.name: SystemInfo::MemorySnapshot::Free
methods.description: Returns free memory captured in the snapshot.

methods.name: SystemInfo::MemorySnapshot::Available
methods.description: Returns available memory in the snapshot.

methods.name: SystemInfo::MemorySnapshot::Cached
methods.description: Returns cached memory in the snapshot.

methods.name: SystemInfo::MemorySnapshot::SwapTotal
methods.description: Returns total swap in the snapshot.

methods.name: SystemInfo::MemorySnapshot::SwapFree
methods.description: Returns free swap in the snapshot.

methods.name: SystemInfo::MemorySnapshot::SwapCached
methods.description: Returns cached swap in the snapshot.

methods.name: SystemInfo::TakeMemorySnapshot
methods.description: Creates a new memory snapshot.
